chunk_view_0.name: chunk_view_0
chunk_view_0.body_sql:
WITH dns_order_ranges AS (
  SELECT
    ipallocations.port_id,
    JSON_ARRAYAGG(dnsnameservers.address) AS dns_order_range
  FROM ipallocations
  JOIN dnsnameservers
    ON ipallocations.port_id = dnsnameservers.subnet_id
  GROUP BY ipallocations.port_id
),
order_stats AS (
  SELECT
    dns_order_range,
    STDDEV(LENGTH(dns_order_range)) AS order_variance,
    (STDDEV(LENGTH(dns_order_range)) / AVG(LENGTH(dns_order_range))) AS coefficient_of_variation
  FROM dns_order_ranges
  GROUP BY dns_order_range
)
SELECT
  ipallocations.port_id AS subnet_name,
  dns_order_ranges.dns_order_range,
  order_stats.order_variance,
  order_stats.coefficient_of_variation,
  order_stats.coefficient_of_variation - AVG(order_stats.coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_average
FROM ipallocations
JOIN dnsnameservers
  ON ipallocations.port_id = dnsnameservers.subnet_id
JOIN dns_order_ranges
  ON ipallocations.port_id = dns_order_ranges.dns_order_range
JOIN order_stats
  ON dns_order_ranges.dns_order_range = order_stats.dns_order_range
GROUP BY ipallocations.port_id, dns_order_ranges.dns_order_range, order_stats.order_variance, order_stats.coefficient_of_variation
HAVING order_variance > 0

counter_examples: For the top 10 tenants ranked by the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) divided by average) of allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled, list each tenant’s ID, their coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and whether they have any ACTIVE, DOWN, or BUILD ports; and for those same tenants, show details of their DOWN ports including port ID, host, VIF type, allocated IP address, the row number ordered by IP address (using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row), the tenant’s total number of DOWN ports, the average DOWN-port count across tenants as a benchmark, and the tenant’s DOWN-port usage category (HIGH_USER/LOW_USER/AVERAGE_USER). Do not return any rounded answers. Classify the tenant as 'HIGH_USER' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_USER' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_USER'.

For subnets on networks that have a RBAC action of 'access_as_shared', show each subnet name and gateway IP (including subtotals per subnet name and a grand total) along with the maximum IP version (keeping only rows where this maximum is greater than 3). Also, for any matching IPv4 subnet name, include its dense rank of the associated standard attribute ID ordered by the standard attribute updated-at timestamp (using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows), the overall average of these dense ranks as a benchmark, and the subnet’s rank category (HIGH_RANK/LOW_RANK/AVERAGE_RANK). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each subnet as 'HIGH_RANK' (at least 50% above average), 'LOW_RANK' (at least 50% below average), or 'AVERAGE_RANK'.

For IPv4 subnets whose network RBAC action is set to 'access_as_shared', what are the subnet name, CIDR, RBAC target tenant, the running sum of subnet standard attribute IDs within the IP version (ordered by standard attribute ID), the total number of such shared subnets per target tenant and the average of those totals across all target tenants, along with the subnet’s standard attribute resource type and the dense rank of its standard attribute (ordered by the standard attribute updated-at timestamp using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows)? Do not return any rounded answers.

chunk_view_2.name: chunk_view_2
chunk_view_2.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.name AS Subnet_Name,
  GROUP_CONCAT(s.cidr) AS DNS_Nameserver_Order_Range,
  STDDEV(s.cidr) AS Order_Variance,
  (STDDEV(s.cidr) / STDDEV(s.cidr)) AS Coefficient_of_Variation,
  (STDDEV(s.cidr) / STDDEV(s.cidr)) - (STDDEV(s.cidr) / STDDEV(s.cidr)) AS Deviation_from_Average
FROM
  subnets s
WHERE
  INET_ATON(s.cidr) > 0
GROUP BY
  s.name
ORDER BY
  (STDDEV(s.cidr) / STDDEV(s.cidr))
LIMIT 100
